faqs.a:
The board shall serve without pay and shall consist of seven trustees, as follows:
(1)
Director of finance (or designee);
(2)
Director of human resources (or designee);
(3)
One resident citizen of the City of Arvada not otherwise employed by the city or affiliated
                  with the retirement system, appointed by city council;
(4)
Four members of the retirement system, to be elected by the members of the retirement
                  system.
The four members of the retirement system shall serve for a term of two years, pursuant
               to such rules and regulations as the board may adopt.
(Code 1960, § 19-2(A); Code 1981, § 26-28; Ord. No. 2227, § 7, 10-21-1985; Ord. No.
               3099, § § 1, 2, 7-11-1994;
Ord. No. 4155, § 1, 2-2-2009
)
